## Project case studies

- [Kartel Daun (Botanical Emporium)](https://simeon.id/projects/kartel-daun/): An omnichannel commerce platform and operational ERP for botanical exports, covering storefront, inventory, customs documentation, payments, and international logistics.
- [PlantEx (Global Flora Exporter)](https://simeon.id/projects/plantex/): A plant export and supply-chain platform for order consolidation, flight schedules, packing calculations, customs documentation, invoicing, and multi-gateway payments.
- [Kasira (Tavern Merchant POS)](https://simeon.id/projects/kasira/): A cloud restaurant POS covering table layouts, menus, checkout, thermal receipts, QR ordering, role-based access, and real-time kitchen displays.
- [Levelup (Gamified Productivity)](https://simeon.id/projects/levelup/): An RPG productivity PWA that turns habits and tasks into quests, XP, boss battles, avatar progression, and branching skill trees with offline support.
- [SisiKita (Odd Pair Matcher)](https://simeon.id/projects/sisikita/): A social utility platform for matching single-sided footwear and apparel, with listings, direct messaging, moderation, and automated candidate pairing.
- [YT Tools (Broadcast Automator)](https://simeon.id/projects/yt-tools/): A continuous YouTube streaming pipeline for scheduled media loops, FFmpeg encoding, automatic restart handling, and WebSocket health telemetry.
